title: PR review and fix with proof

branch.label: Branch to review, when no range is given

base_branch.label: Branch the review branch started from

steps.title: Check out the head in a worktree
Pick what to fix
steps.gate_summary: {{steps.picks.outputs.picks}} findings are ticked, every one both engines agree on. Edit {{steps.picks.outputs.picks_abs}} to tick others by id (see {{steps.review.outputs.buckets_abs}}), then approve to fix them. Reject to stop.

steps.title: Fix the picked findings
steps.prompt: Read {{steps.review.outputs.buckets_abs}} and {{steps.picks.outputs.picks_abs}}. Fix only the findings whose id is in the "pick" list, in this worktree. Leave every other finding alone. Do not commit and do not push. Then write {{run.dir}}/fixes.json with one entry per picked finding id: {"fixes": [{"finding": "<id>", "status": "fixed", "proof": {"kind": "test", "test": "<test file>::<test name>", "command": "<one command that runs only that test>"}}, {"finding": "<id>", "status": "fixed", "proof": {"kind": "diff"}}, {"finding": "<id>", "status": "not-fixed", "reason": "<one line>"}]}. Prefer a test proof: a test that fails on the original code and passes on your fix. Use a diff proof only when no test can show it. Never mark a finding fixed without one of these.
